PSG Defeats Aston Villa 2-1 to Retain UEFA Super Cup

Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) successfully defended their UEFA Super Cup title by defeating Aston Villa 2-1. The match saw goals from Kvaratskhelia and Doue for PSG, while 17-year-old Brian Madjo scored for Aston Villa. This victory marks PSG's second consecutive Super Cup win and adds to manager Luis Enrique's 13th trophy since joining the club in 2023. PSG's win continues their dominance in European football.
